titulo: Record commencement of service in Personnel
subtitulo: Review the post and terms for the person who accepted the call.
ayuda: The person has a confirmed acceptance. Check the selection and period before recording their start of work. If the result is pending, check this same operation before repeating it. Official signing is a separate step.
persona_pendiente: The accepted person's identity has not yet been verified
sin_puestos: No posts are available for this case. Human Resources must review the staffing arrangements before proceeding.
hasta_exclusiva: The end date is the first day outside the period.
periodo_pendiente: The case does not yet specify a period. Human Resources must explicitly set it.
plan_preparado: The details are prepared. Commencement of service has not yet been confirmed.
registro_pendiente: The outcome cannot be confirmed. Check the same operation before starting another.
opcion_ya_no_disponible: Your previous choice has changed. Select a current option.
seleccion_obsoleta: The selection has changed. Check this operation before continuing again.
error_periodo: The end date must be later than the start date.
denegada: You do not have permission to view or record this commencement of service. The screen data has been cleared.
conflicto: The case or selection has changed. Refresh the options before proceeding.
no_disponible: Commencement of service cannot be checked right now. Select Refresh options. If the problem persists, contact IT.
rechazada: The operation was not accepted. Review the details before proceeding.
faltan_comprobaciones: Complete the pending checks before recording commencement of service.
pendientes_antes_legacy: This commencement in Personnel has pending checks. If the case follows the earlier process, check its commencement of service.
confirmada: Commencement of service recorded in Personnel
siguiente: You can view follow-up for this case.
limite: Recording the start of work does not complete official signing or give the document administrative effect.
sin_documento: No document is available. Review the appointment formalities before proceeding.
sin_catalogos: Personnel terms are unavailable. Human Resources must review the catalogues.
revision_lista: Review these details before recording commencement of service.
